unit: WS-O O-012 (CMP-A12) — verify reopen/quote/revision/WO handoff preserves references, BOM, drawings, and costs
reverified_note: all seven touched files byte-identical between the two heads; candidate diffs apply cleanly at 2e661df9
transport: local candidate copies under .audit-work/foundation-o012-handoff/candidates/ — NO remote writes performed or permitted for this unit
evidence_class: synthetic/model only — no live business records were created, read, or mutated

changes: sourceProjectTotal foundation branch: trust the persisted 12-field split partition first; grand_total only when no split field carries a number (fixes null-poison -> $0 and foreign grand_total undercount)
new shared helper foundationSplitFieldTotal(record) so the live path and the acknowledged comparator cannot disagree about the partition
foundationRecordSavedTotal: same partition-first ordering, grand_total last-resort, null when nothing persisted

recordBuilderSave: fail closed when the source-only hint resolves to no estimate line (was: || line fallback minted an orphan BuilderProduct with an estimate_line_id that never lands in line_items, then errored forever)

new resolveFoundationSyncReceiptForSave({project, estimateId, getEstimate}): receipt naming a different estimate that can still be read stays authoritative; a definitively-absent (404) named estimate retires the orphaned receipt (clearStaleReceipt) so the standalone editor is unbricked; unverifiable probes stay blocked (fail closed)
saveSource prior-receipt gate replaced by resolveFoundationSyncReceiptForSave (same strictness for live/malformed receipts; orphan retirement added)
updateBuilderSourceProject data writes builder_sync_attempt: null through the same CAS patch when the resolver retires an orphaned receipt

new assertNoPendingLinesForCopy(lines, action): refuses to copy a section carrying a durable Builder recovery marker into a different estimate record (the marker's estimate_id would be unresumable and would lock the target's Product/Part mutations up to the 24h stale TTL while permanently breaking that section's reconciliation)
handleMerge calls assertNoPendingLinesForCopy(picked) after selection resolution (baseline only guarded the PRIMARY estimate's own pending state)
buildDuplicateEstimate guards cloned lines with assertNoPendingLinesForCopy (duplicate keeps verbatim line_items incl. price_acceptance_pending)
buildSplitEstimate defers the same guard to after its selection filter via skipPendingGuard so an unpicked pending line does not block a clean split

extractFoundation: coerce persisted subsection arrays (items/walls/poles/wall_caps/selected_equipment/signage_cabinets/project_concrete_admixtures) once at entry — getSourceProject feeds the raw stored row into this extractor during estimate reconciliation and a malformed non-array subsection crashed the whole handoff

gaps.title: sourceProjectTotal/foundationRecordSavedTotal grand_total poison
gaps.evidence: num(null, NaN) === 0 (finite), so grand_total:null short-circuits to $0 ahead of the 12-field partition; any foreign numeric grand_total (the field is never persisted by the Builder per its own comment) undercounts records whose saved partition includes newer extras (cabinet/landscape). Hit on the estimate-reopen reconcile path via getSourceProject -> ensureBuilderProductForLine -> sourceProjectTotal.
gaps.fix: partition-first in both functions via shared foundationSplitFieldTotal; grand_total only when no split field exists
gaps.cases: C1 C2 (RED vs baseline), C3 C4 C5 (parity)

gaps.title: orphaned builder_sync_attempt permanently bricks standalone saves
gaps.evidence: saveSource prior-gate requires prior.estimate_id === captured.estimateId; a receipt naming a deleted estimate (or a raced duplicate-estimate context) can never satisfy that, so every future save — including standalone ?id= context — threw 'unrecognised Builder sync receipt' forever.
gaps.fix: resolveFoundationSyncReceiptForSave probes the named estimate via the same staffDataRead 404 contract; definitively-absent -> retire receipt with the next CAS save; live -> keep blocking with an actionable message; unverifiable -> keep blocking
gaps.cases: B4 B7 (RED), B1 B2 B3 B5 B6 (guard parity)

gaps.title: recordBuilderSave mints orphan BuilderProduct when the hint's estimate line was removed
gaps.evidence: currentLine fell back to the bare hint (|| line) when no line matched; ensureBuilderProductForLine then created a BuilderProduct with a fresh estimate_line_id that never lands in line_items, after which the preMarker/acknowledgment checks threw 'not part of the estimate' on every retry — permanent orphan row + endless partial sync.
gaps.fix: throw 'no longer part of the estimate' before any write when the hint resolves to no estimate line
gaps.cases: D2 (RED), D1 (GREEN handoff), D3 D4 (CAS guards)

gaps.title: merge/duplicate/split transplant unresumable price_acceptance_pending markers
gaps.evidence: handleMerge copied picked lines verbatim and only guarded the primary's own pending state; buildDuplicateEstimate/buildSplitEstimate clone line_items verbatim with no pending check at all. A copied marker's estimate_id names the source estimate — getPendingEstimatePriceAcceptance on the target does not verify ownership, so the target locks for up to 24h and the section can never reconcile (marker validation rejects the copied record id forever).
gaps.fix: assertNoPendingLinesForCopy in builderMutationRecovery, applied at merge (picked lines), duplicate (whole clone), and split (picked lines only via skipPendingGuard deferral)
gaps.cases: H1 H3 H4 (RED: lock + unresumable ownership proven), H2 (clean merge parity)

gaps.title: extractFoundation crashes on malformed persisted subsection arrays
gaps.evidence: (project.walls || []).forEach etc. tolerate null/undefined but not non-array truthy values or non-object rows; getSourceProject feeds the raw stored record (no page normalization) during estimate open/strict-reconcile, and cloneFoundationComponents' own comments document malformed stored rows existing. One corrupt subsection crashed the entire Builder handoff.
gaps.fix: coerce row arrays + filter non-object rows once at extractFoundation entry
gaps.cases: F4 (RED vs baseline: crash -> graceful [] on the same inputs)

ledger: O-012 verified the Foundation handoff chain on synthetic records: ?id= reopen is a cache-free point read of the exact persisted record; source saves are CAS + idempotent-retry safe; builder_sync_attempt receipts are shape+ownership validated on both the save gate and the recovery path; recordBuilderSave preserves line_id/project_id/builder_product_id and stamps updated_date_snapshot on the acknowledged revision; quote and WO surfaces consume the acknowledged snapshots; extractFoundation keys survive clone/remap round-trips. Five real gaps were found and surgically hardened in candidates only: grand_total poisoning of sourceProjectTotal/foundationRecordSavedTotal (G1), orphaned receipts bricking standalone saves (G2), orphan BuilderProduct minting on raced section removal (G3), merge/duplicate/split transplanting unresumable recovery markers (G4), and extractFoundation crashing on malformed persisted subsections (G5). Model suite 36/36 incl. 14 RED cases proving each baseline defect. Real business-record lifecycle evidence is explicitly OPEN and not claimed.
